statements.statement: CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) was billed for this patient
The patient has a diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a diagnosis of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The service was ordered to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances through extended ambulatory assessment
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
CPT 93271 represents a distinct diagnostic evaluation that should not be treated as bundled and non-payable
